sections.label: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure 2024-2025
sections.summary: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 are in Paper Cmd 33 of 2025, with no amendments, so Heads of Expenditure are taken en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, contained in Paper Cmd 33 of 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I will first take Heads E, J, M, P, Q, T, W and Z of the Supplementary Main Estimates.
